headline: ACME Solar commissions 17.91 MW battery storage in Rajasthan
hook: New capacity scheduled for October 25 launch
summary: ACME Solar has commissioned an additional battery storage capacity of 17.91 MW through its unit ACME Sigma Urja in Rajasthan. This expansion brings the company's total operational battery storage capacity to 71.64 MW. Commercial operations for the newly added capacity are scheduled to commence on October 25. Indian retail investors tracking the renewable energy sector should note this incremental capacity addition.
why_it_matters: Incremental capacity expansion strengthens ACME Solar's operational footprint.

headline: Acme Solar starts commercial operations at its Rajasthan battery storage project
summary: Acme Solar Holdings has commenced commercial production and operations for its Battery Energy Storage System project located in Rajasthan. This project adds operational renewable energy infrastructure to the company's portfolio. For Indian retail investors, utility-scale storage projects reflect progress in India's renewable integration strategy, impacting clean energy sector valuations.
why_it_matters: Renewable asset expansion builds cash flow visibility for Acme Solar.

headline: ACME Solar signs a 300 MW peak-supply power purchase agreement with SECI
hook: New peak-supply contract secured with SECI
summary: ACME Solar Holdings has signed a power purchase agreement (PPA) with the Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) for a 300 MW / 1200 MWh assured peak supply Firm and Dispatchable Renewable Energy (FDRE) project. The tariff for the project is set at INR 6 per unit. This contract expands the company's operational portfolio in the renewable energy sector. Indian retail investors should note this major order win as it strengthens ACME Solar's revenue pipeline in the green energy space.
why_it_matters: Order win strengthens ACME Solar's renewable revenue pipeline
winners_losers: ACME Solar gains / power peers neutral
